name: ilogic-formatter
description: Formatter for Autodesk Inventor iLogic rules (.iLogicVb files)

ilogicFormatter.indentSize.description: Number of spaces per indentation level.

ilogicFormatter.useTabs.description: Use tabs instead of spaces for indentation.

ilogicFormatter.maxBlankLines.description: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines to allow.

ilogicFormatter.blankLineAfterBlock.description: Insert a blank line after End Sub / End Function / End Property.

ilogicFormatter.normalizeKeywords.description: Normalize VB.NET keyword casing (e.g. dim → Dim, if → If).

ilogicFormatter.normalizeComments.description: Ensure a space after the comment apostrophe (e.g. 'comment → ' comment).

ilogicFormatter.normalizeUnicode.description: Replace lookalike Unicode characters in code with their ASCII equivalents (e.g. en dash → hyphen, curly quote delimiters → straight quotes). String literals and comment text are never changed.

ilogicFormatter.formatVbFiles.description: Also format .vb files. Turn off if you work on regular VB.NET projects and want another formatter for them.

scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --out ilogic-formatter.vsix
